## ⚠️ IMPORTANT

**For security vulnerabilities, DO NOT open a public issue.** Instead:

1. Go to https://github.com/ahmedkobbi/veriface-edge/security/advisories/new
2. Click "Report a vulnerability"
3. Fill in the details privately

This template is for tracking purposes only — please use the Security Advisories feature for actual reports.
